_note: Ground truth for the deep/light triage (C0). The axis is QUALITY OF A DIRECT ANSWER: a direct ask gets the truth → light; the truth needs indirection (cliché trap, social desirability, mental model, too-big) → deep. Strategic != deep (JTBD label is strategic but light). Edit `expect`, re-run scripts/eval-triage.mjs.

cases.q: how do they feel about the community feature
what do people think of our pricing page
how satisfied are people with onboarding
do they like the new dashboard design
how was their experience with support last time
would they recommend us to a friend
how often do people use boards
did people notice the new export button
what's confusing about the signup flow
why do power users export to a spreadsheet instead of dashboards
cases.why: why behind a behavior, askable behaviorally

cases.q: what's the real job people hire us for
cases.why: JTBD label — strategic but directly statable

cases.q: how important is the community board vs recruiting privately
what are people's complaints and struggles

cases.why: cliché trap — flat ask gives 'too expensive'; truth needs indirection + right people

cases.why: pricing strategy / value, not the page — too big, cliché-trapped

cases.why: real unmet need behind a feature wishlist

how do people mentally categorize our product
